firm_data.firm_name: Golden Rothschild Spagnola Lundell Boylan Garubo & Bell P.C.
firm_data.firm_description: Golden Rothschild Spagnola Lundell Boylan Garubo & Bell P.C. is a New Jersey and New York law firm with over 50 years of experience defending clients. They offer associates the opportunity to gain hands-on litigation experience and exposure to the firm’s diverse legal practice.
notable_facts: GRSLBG&B has been defending clients for over 50 years.
The firm has offices in Bridgewater, New Jersey and New York, New York.
GRSLBG&B offers a hybrid-work model with the flexibility to work remotely.

email.subject: AI for Golden Rothschild Spagnola Lundell Boylan Garubo & Bell
email.body:
Hi there,

Over 50 years defending clients across General Liability, Construction, and Professional Liability matters from Bridgewater, GRSLBG&B has built something rare: deep expertise paired with lean efficiency. That combination is exactly what we see in the best firms we work with.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with smaller teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us because we focus on what matters to practices like yours: precision, client trust, and the ability to compete without doubling headcount.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding our reach. I'd be happy to stop by your Bridgewater office to show how our ex-lawyer team is helping similar firms do more with their current resources.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
